questions.question: Dr. Soundous has received a complaint from a patient against his colleague. According to Article 50 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Inform his colleague of the complaint
Direct the patient to the official procedure
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist must direct the patient to the official complaint procedure with the council of the order.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will give him the council's contact details.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad is confronted with a conflict with his colleague concerning a shared patient. According to Article 53 of the Code of Ethics, what is the procedure to follow?
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Article 53 encourages joint consultation in the patient's interest.' Dr. Imad: 'I will propose a meeting with my colleague and the patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who asks him to falsify a treatment date for insurance reasons. According to Article 9 of the Code of Ethics, what is the response?
options: Accept if the patient pays a supplement
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Article 9 prohibits establishing a biased report. Falsifying a date is a serious offense.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will refuse and explain why to my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad discovers that his colleague has sexual relations with a patient. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: Ignore the situation because it concerns private life
Report to the council of the order
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Sexual relations with a patient constitute a serious ethical fault. The dentist has a duty to report this situation to the council of the order.' Dr. Imad: 'I will refer the matter to the council of the order.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who has suffered harm related to a treatment. He is considering filing a complaint against the colleague. According to Article 50 of the Code of Ethics, what should Dr. Soundous do?
options: Encourage the patient to file a complaint
Remain impartial and direct the patient to the appropriate procedures
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist must remain impartial and direct the patient to the appropriate procedures, without influencing their decision.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will inform them of their rights without taking sides.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who refuses to pay his fees. According to Article 6 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Discuss with the patient and propose a payment plan
Immediately take the matter to court
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The first step is dialogue to find an amicable solution, in accordance with Article 6 which prohibits imposing a payment method.' Dr. Imad: 'I will offer him a meeting to discuss.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is approached by a colleague who proposes sharing commissions on prescriptions. According to Article 16 of the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: Accept because it is common practice
Refuse because sharing commissions is prohibited
Accept if the prescriptions are justified
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Article 16 prohibits any payment, acceptance, or sharing of money between practitioners. Sharing commissions is formally prohibited.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will refuse and report this practice.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient suffering from a chronic condition. He must deliver bad news. According to the principle of beneficence, how should he proceed?
options: Announce the news with empathy and give the patient time
Say nothing to avoid shocking them
Announce the news to the family first
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Delivering bad news should be done with empathy, respecting the patient's pace.' Dr. Imad: 'I will take the time to explain and support my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who filed a complaint against him for an unsatisfactory aesthetic result. According to Article 20 of the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: He must demonstrate that he informed the patient of the limits of the treatment
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist is not bound by an obligation of result. He must demonstrate that he informed the patient of the limits and risks.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will present my file to the council.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who was treated by a colleague and is in distress. According to Article 41 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Offer his help while respecting the colleague
Take over the patient without informing the colleague
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist must help the patient in distress while respecting their colleague, without criticizing them.' Dr. Imad: 'I will offer my help to the patient and contact his colleague.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is consulted by a patient who is also followed by a colleague. He discovers a different diagnosis. According to Article 53 of the Code of Ethics, what is the procedure?
options: Propose a joint consultation with the colleague
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The joint consultation allows discussion of different diagnoses in the patient's interest.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will organize a meeting with my colleague.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who has missed several appointments. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Discuss with the patient to understand the situation and find a solution
Remove them from the patient list
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'Dialogue is preferable to understand the reasons for missed appointments and find a solution together.' Dr. Imad: 'I will contact my patient to discuss it.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who wishes teeth whitening while having untreated cavities. According to the principle of beneficence, what is the right attitude?
options: Treat the cavities first, then offer whitening
Perform both treatments at the same time
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The principle of beneficence requires treating pathologies first before aesthetic requests.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will explain to my patient the importance of treating the cavities first.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad discovers that his assistant has stolen medication. According to Article 4 of the Code of Ethics, what is his responsibility?
options: He must take disciplinary measures and report to the Order
He must wait for the patient's complaint
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist is responsible for what happens in his practice. He must take disciplinary measures against his assistant and report the theft to the Order.' Dr. Imad: 'I will dismiss her and notify the Order.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient with a history of depression. He must announce a long treatment. According to the principle of beneficence, how should he proceed?
options: Adapt the announcement to the patient
Entrust the announcement to another dentist
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The announcement must be adapted to the patient's psychological state, with empathy and support.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will take the time to explain and reassure my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who wishes treatment outside the conventional framework. According to Article 30 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: He must inform the patient of the non-conventional nature
He must ask the Order's opinion
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist must inform the patient of the non-conventional nature of the treatment and the financial implications.' Dr. Imad: 'I will provide a detailed estimate to my patient.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is asked to provide a judicial expert opinion concerning a colleague. According to Article 50 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Accept while remaining impartial and objective
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist-expert must remain impartial and objective, without bias for or against his colleague.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will conduct an objective expertise.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient with a rare condition. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Propose a consultation with a specialist
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist must refer the patient to a specialist if they do not master the condition, in accordance with Article 24 on informed care.' Dr. Imad: 'I will recommend a specialist colleague.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who has changed dentists several times. According to the principle of beneficence, what is the right attitude?
options: Welcome the patient and try to understand their expectations
Refer them back to their former dentists
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist must welcome any patient and try to understand their expectations to better treat them.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will take the time to listen to them.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who refuses a root canal treatment and prefers extraction. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: Inform the patient of the advantages and disadvantages of both options
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist must inform the patient of the different options, then respect their informed choice.' Dr. Imad: 'I will explain both options to them.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is confronted with a patient who has suicidal thoughts. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Take the patient seriously and refer them to a psychologist
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The dentist has a duty of assistance. They must take suicidal thoughts seriously and refer the patient to a psychologist or psychiatrist.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will refer them to a psychologist.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who asks him for help to lie to his employer. According to Article 9 of the Code of Ethics, what is the response?
options: Refuse because any form of deception is prohibited
Accept if the patient is in difficulty
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist must never participate in deception. He must refuse and remind the patient of ethical rules.' Dr. Imad: 'I will refuse and explain why.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient with a different diagnosis from his colleague's. According to Article 53 of the Code of Ethics, how should he proceed?
options: Inform the patient of the different diagnosis
Propose a joint consultation with the colleague
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'The joint consultation allows discussion of different diagnoses and finding the best solution for the patient.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will organize a meeting with the colleague.'

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who insists on a treatment he does not master. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Perform the treatment to satisfy the patient
Refuse and refer to a specialist colleague
Perform the treatment with the help of a colleague
questions.explanation: Dr. Soundous explains: 'The dentist has a duty to perform only procedures they master. Referring to a specialist is a sign of responsibility.' Dr. Imad: 'I will recommend an expert colleague.'

questions.question: Dr. Soundous, after managing several ethical conflicts, receives congratulations from Dr. Imad. What is the next step for Dr. Soundous?
options: Become an expert in dental ethics and deontology
questions.explanation: Dr. Imad explains: 'Mastery of ethical conflict management is a valuable skill. Becoming an ethics expert is the next step.' Dr. Soundous: 'I will train in advanced medical ethics.'
